arguments.command:
cd /app && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys
from collections import Counter
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp'); import gen5
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/app/submission/main.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
fr=Counter(); conns_seen=Counter(); cmax=0; obsfrac=Counter()
for seed in range(0,700):
    doc=gen5.gen(seed)
    a=m.build_result(doc)
    for sp in ('dev','eval'):
        r=a['reports'][sp]
        conns_seen[(sp, r['connections']>0)]+=1
        if r['connections']>0: obsfrac[r['connections']]+=1
        if r['macro_f1']!=[0,1]: fr[tuple(r['macro_f1'])]+=1
        cmax=max(cmax, r['connections'])
print("distinct non-trivial macro_f1 fractions:", len(fr), "sample:", list(fr)[:10])
print("split/observed coverage:", dict(conns_seen))
print("max connections in a split:", cmax, "| observed-count histogram head:", sorted(obsfrac.items())[:12])
EOF
